input.subject: Exciting Opportunity at Acme Corp
input.message_body:
Hello,

I came across your profile and I think you'd be a great fit for a Senior Engineer role at Acme Corp. The compensation is very competitive — around ₹65 LPA for the right candidate.

Would you be free for a quick call this week? I can share more details over the call. If you prefer, we can also chat on WhatsApp — it's faster for me.

Looking forward!

Regards,
Deepak Sharma
Talent Acquisition
input.conversation_summary: Cold first message. Mentions WhatsApp but doesn't insist. Salary disclosed without an interview.
